name: Suritozole
summary: Suritozole (MDL 26,479) is an investigational cognition enhancer. It acts as a partial inverse agonist at the benzodiazepine receptor site on the GABAA ion channel complex, but does not have either anxiogenic or convulsant effects, unlike other BZD inverse agonists such as DMCM.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a partial inverse agonist at the benzodiazepine receptor site on the GABAA ion channel complex, but does not have either anxiogenic or convulsant effects, unlike other BZD inverse agonists such as DMCM.

uses.text: It was investigated for the treatment of depression and Alzheimer's disease in the 90s, but clinical development seems to have been discontinued.

fact.en: Drugs that push the benzodiazepine site in the opposite direction, called inverse agonists, usually cause anxiety or seizures. Suritozole stood out because it did neither in animal tests.
fact.zh: 在苯二氮平結合位上產生相反作用的藥物稱為反向促效劑，通常會引起焦慮或癲癇發作。舒立托唑的特別之處在於，動物實驗中它兩者都沒有引起。
fact.zhHans: 在苯二氮平结合位上产生相反作用的药物称为反向促效剂，通常会引起焦虑或癫痫发作。舒立托唑的特别之处在于，动物实验中它两者都没有引起。
